menu.title: Merge & dig
menu.tagline: Merge the balls, drop them and dig ever deeper.
menu.rule1: Tap a ball, then another of the same level, to merge them. A higher level means more power.
menu.rule2: DROP! throws balls at blocks. Broken blocks pay coins. A block's color shows its health.
menu.rule3: Spend coins on new balls, upgrades, blasts and bombs. You can also sell balls. Progress saves itself.
war.title: ⚔ War of Balls
war.help: 🔥 burns enemies (damage over time) · ❄ slows their attacks · ☠ weakens the rest once an enemy falls. The 5 strongest balls from your board and inventory march to war. A loss has a 50% chance to cost one random fighting ball. The enemy rolls within ±3 levels of your account level (⭐ grows with digging and wins).

stats.title: ⭐ Statistics
stats.help: Each account level grants 1 point. The higher your level, the tougher the mine blocks (+5% health per level), so points help you keep up rather than beat the game.
